1.1.0.0.added: Initial feature spec for the Addon.

1.2.0.0.added: Introduce a public scripting API  This change centralizes buff/stat logic for easier maintenance and enables direct use from C3 JS Scripting + Update Guide accordingly.

1.3.0.0.added:
- Add Scripting Support 
- Debugger support, shows same properties as the built-in Platform Movement Behavior.

1.4.0.0.added:
- Adds animation-mode.
- knockback conditions/expressions.
- improve robustness of floor/wall detection across collision shapes.
- Debugger properties are editable.
- ACE to overwrite whether character is "on the Floor" (Grounded)

1.4.1.0.added:
- Adds animation-mode.
- knockback conditions/expressions.
- improve robustness of floor/wall detection across collision shapes.
- Debugger properties are editable.
- ACE to overwrite whether character is "on the Floor" (Grounded)

1.4.2.0.changed: Rename the knockback feature to a more general "driven move"

1.4.3.0.added:
- Add wall-coyote support and improve ACE docs/usability hints. 
- Add IsAbilityEnabled to include the new wall Coyote Time.
-
1.4.3.0.fixed: - refine descriptions across many conditions, actions and expressions to provide clearer usage hints

1.5.0.0.added: - Add Actions to Toggle whether character is touching a ceiling.
1.5.0.0.changed: - Knockback, given a more descriptive name to understand its versatility better. "Driven Movement"

1.5.1.0.changed:
- Improve Wall Detection (Slop Tolerance variable actually works)
- The 2-frame grace delays real "fallen off edge" detection (to help mitigate issues from Box2D contact jitters)
1.5.1.0.fixed: - fix landing bounce (atches residual bounce regardless of the Physics behaviour settings)

1.6.0.0.added:
- "ContactGrace" expression, returns the current grace duration
- "Set contact grace" action, change the grace window at runtime

1.6.1.0.added: - Contact Grace is viewable and editable in the Debugger

1.7.0.0.added:
- Wall Jump Input Lock property (default 0.15s) and "Set wall jump input lock" action: briefly ignores input toward the wall after a wall jump
- "Enabled" property (default On) to start the behavior disabled
1.7.0.0.changed:
- A wall jump's horizontal push can exceed Max Speed and eases off at the Deceleration rate (other speed above Max Speed still snaps to it, as before)
- Contact classification measures from the bounding box (works with any origin)
- Properties reordered: Debug Mode first, Wall Jump Input Lock beside the other wall jump settings, Enabled last. Existing projects keep their values
- Migration: with contact grace working again, Is on floor / Is on wall stay true ~0.05s after contact ends, so On fallen off fires ~3 frames later than in 1.6.x. Set contact grace to 0 to restore 1.6.x timing
1.7.0.0.fixed:
- Wall slide / wall jump with box collision shapes (wall corners were read as floor + ceiling)
- Jumping while pressed against a wall (false ceiling bonk)
- Wall detection on mirrored/flipped sprites
- Floor/wall detection with non-centered image origins (e.g. bottom-center)
- Contact grace had no effect since 1.6.0
- No phantom landing when spawned, re-enabled or loaded in mid-air
- Contact grace and wall jump lock saved/loaded; older saves keep the object's property values
